1_incident_name: Silverwood Reservoir Crude Oil Pipeline Rupture
4_subject: Skimmer Vessel Relocation and Sorbent Boom Realignment
7_message: Due to shifts in surface currents toward Sawpit Canyon inlet, requesting authorization to reposition Skimmer Vessel RV-LC-01 to South Arm and deploy an additional 500 feet of hard containment boom by 22:00 hours.
9_reply: Operations Chief approves relocation of RV-LC-01 and deployment of 500 feet hard boom. Work Boat 3 assigned to assist boom rigging.
